headline: Which law firms are advising on Anthropic's IPO?
sum: Five international law firms - including Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati, Freshfields, Cravath, Swaine & Moore, Orrick and Cleary Gottlieb Steen & Hamilton - are advising artificial intelligence company Anthropic and various stakeholders…
detail: Five international law firms - including Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati, Freshfields, Cravath, Swaine & Moore, Orrick and Cleary Gottlieb Steen & Hamilton - are advising artificial intelligence company Anthropic and various stakeholders in connection with its proposed initial public offering (IPO) in the United States. The details emerged from the registration statement filed by Anthropic with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on October 26. Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati is acting as counsel to Anthropic for the public offering, while Freshfields US LLP is advising the underwriters, led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley.
